newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissen ask-only on revised forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nissen ask-only on revised forecast.

text.p: Nissen Co Ltd shares were ask-only on Tuesday morning as investors sold the shares, depressed by the firm's lower earnings forecast announced on Monday, brokers said.
As of 0146 GMT, the shares of the mail-order firm were ask-only at 390 yen after closing at 420 yen the previous day.
Nissen said on Monday that in the six months to June 20, 1997, it expected a parent current loss of 950 million yen compared with an earlier forecast of a 550 million yen profit.

"In the mail-order business, competition is intensifying as many foreign firms are entering the business," a broker at a second-tier brokerage house said. "Investors are discouraged that the firm's profits are not improving."
